## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Release/maintenance

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] I removed secrets, credentials, tokens, private citizen data, and production-only values.
- [ ] I did not commit `.env*` files, generated logs, build output, or private credentials.
- [ ] I updated docs when behavior, setup, environment variables, security limits, or deployment changed.
- [ ] I avoided unsupported claims about official data, production security, scale, adoption, or performance.
- [ ] I read `SECURITY.md` and did not include vulnerability details that belong in a private report.
